prune() {
  echo "[image-cleaner] pruning unused images on $(hostname)"
  /var/lib/rancher/k3s/data/current/bin/crictl \
    -r unix:///run/k3s/containerd/containerd.sock rmi --prune
  echo "[image-cleaner] prune done on $(hostname)"
}
prune
while true; do
  now=$(date +%s)
  next=$(date -d "02:00" +%s)
  [ "$next" -le "$now" ] && next=$((next + 86400))
  sleep $((next - now))
  prune
done

[INPUT]
  name              kubernetes_events
  tag               k8s_events
  kube_url          https://kubernetes.default.svc:443
  kube_ca_file      /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
  kube_token_file   /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token

[FILTER]
  name    grep
  match   k8s_events
  exclude message already present on machine

[OUTPUT]
  name              http
  match             k8s_events
  host              victoria-logs-server.monitoring.svc.cluster.local
  port              9428
  uri               /insert/jsonline?_stream_fields=type,reason&_msg_field=message&_time_field=date
  format            json_lines
  json_date_format  iso8601
  compress          gzip

dir=/var/lib/matchbox/assets/fedora-coreos
base="https://builds.coreos.fedoraproject.org/prod/streams/$FCOS_STREAM/builds/$FCOS_VERSION/x86_64"
mkdir -p "$dir"
for kind in live-kernel.x86_64 live-initramfs.x86_64.img live-rootfs.x86_64.img; do
  file="fedora-coreos-$FCOS_VERSION-$kind"
  rm -f "$dir/$file" "$dir/$file.sig"
  coreos-installer download --fetch-retries 3 -C "$dir" -u "$base/$file"
  ln -sfn "$file" "$dir/${kind%.x86_64*}${kind#*.x86_64}"
done
echo "$FCOS_VERSION" > "$dir/VERSION"
ls -l "$dir"
